newsitem.title: CHILE: CHILE JAN-MAY FORESTRY EXPORTS DOWN SLIGHTLY.
newsitem.headline: CHILE JAN-MAY FORESTRY EXPORTS DOWN SLIGHTLY.

text.p: Chilean forestry exports totalled $758.5 million in the first five months of the year, down 1.3 percent on the same period last year, mainly because a fall in wood pulp exports in May, said state forestry agency CONAF.
The situation was the reverse of April when strong pulp shipments boosted exports in the first four months of the year compared with the same period 1996.
"But in May, however, there was a drop in exports of chips and newspaper, as well as a fall in wood pulp shipments," said CONAF executive director Jose Antonio Prado.
The only export that rose in May was sawn wood.
Exports of pulp, Chile's top forestry product, were down 10.3 percent in May with chip exports down 9.4 percent and newspaper down 25 percent on the same period last year.
